PlayerAccount.title: PlayerAccount
PlayerAccount.description: Private player account profile and complete native-map game progression save stored per authenticated user UID.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

username.description: Normalized account handle or login identifier.

authProvider.description: Primary authentication method used by the account.

saveVersion.description: Schema version of the embedded SaveData map.

highestChapterCleared.description: Highest campaign chapter cleared by the player.

saveData.description: Complete sanitized SaveData progression map (heroes, gear, runes, currencies, fairProgression, modes, cosmetics, career).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player save was last synchronized.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: PII-free public ranking summary for real players in the Honor Leaderboard.

displayName.description: Player display name shown on rankings.

isPublic.description: Explicit opt-in public visibility flag enforced by security rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was last updated.

BossRaceEntry.title: BossRaceEntry
BossRaceEntry.description: PII-free persistent Weekly Boss Race standing persisted per weekId and authenticated player UID.

bestDamage.description: Highest single-attempt damage dealt to weekly boss.

bestClearTimeMs.description: Fastest clear duration in milliseconds (0 if uncleared).

perfectDodges.description: Perfect dodges executed in the best run.

autoPilotUsed.description: Flag denoting whether Auto-Pilot was enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of first submission for this week.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest best score update.

SeasonStanding.title: SeasonStanding
SeasonStanding.description: PII-free persistent Competitive Season points and Fair-Play Arena record per seasonId and player UID.

weeksParticipated.description: Number of weeks participated in the active season.

equalizedArenaWins.description: Total wins in Fair-Play Equalized Arena mode.

claimedMilestones.description: Bounded list of claimed seasonal tier milestone IDs (max 20).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of season entry creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest standing update.

AssetAdminRecord.title: AssetAdminRecord
AssetAdminRecord.description: Authorized non-Google password admin UID granted by the verified Google owner to mirror uploaded GLB metadata into Firestore.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the linked password admin account.

grantedBy.description: Verified Google owner UID that authorized this admin record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was last confirmed.

AssetInboxItem.title: AssetInboxItem
AssetInboxItem.description: Public read-only metadata mirror of GLB assets uploaded to /admin/assets so build scripts and AI tools can discover chapter uploads without manual link copying.

id.description: UUIDv4 identifier matching the Cloudflare Worker upload record.

path.description: Canonical CDN object path under /assets/Chương <n>/Asset mới/...

size.description: GLB file size in bytes (24 to 120000000).

uploadedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp reported by the upload worker.

isPublic.description: Explicit public catalog visibility flag enforced by security rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inbox metadata record was mirrored.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inbox metadata record was last synced.

/players/{uid}.description: Private player account and complete game progression save, strictly readable and writable only by its authenticated owner.

/leaderboard/{uid}.description: Public PII-free player leaderboard metrics readable when isPublic == true and writable only by the authenticated owner.

/boss_race_entries/{entryId}.description: Public PII-free Weekly Boss Race entries keyed by {weekId}_{uid}, readable when isPublic == true and writable only by the matching authenticated owner.

/season_standings/{standingId}.description: Public PII-free Competitive Season standings keyed by {seasonId}_{uid}, readable when isPublic == true and writable only by the matching authenticated owner.

/asset_admins/{uid}.description: Private allowlist of linked password admin UIDs managed exclusively by the verified Google owner.

/asset_inbox/{assetId}.description: Public read-only mirror of uploaded GLB inbox metadata (isPublic == true), writable exclusively by verified asset administrators.
